why_agent_cannot: accept the project's terms in your own name
what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Get an invitation from a member Ask an existing trusted member of Pi Network to invite you. The homepage names an invitation as the only thing mining requires.
2 Step 2 : Download the Pi mobile app Once you have an invitation, install the app from Google Play . The project's homepage at minepi.com also links the download.
3 Step 3 : Start mining Pi Open the app and begin mining Pi. The project says mining is free and that it works on your phone without draining the battery.
4 Step 4 : Read the whitepaper Read the Pi whitepaper for the mining and token model. The project says its chapters may change as data comes in.
